title: DATESINPERIOD going back one year from December 31 is the whole year
query: EVALUATE VAR R = DATESINPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], DATE ( 2024, 12, 31 ), -1, YEAR ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) )

source.quote: The following expression evaluates the measure Sales Amount in the last 12 months starting from the last day of the period in the filter context.
source.supports: the moving annual total pattern: -1, YEAR from the last day

source.quote: The result has the dates between the start date and the boundary date. The boundary date is not in the result.
source.supports: the boundary, one year back, is excluded

derivation: One year back from 2024-12-31 the boundary is 2023-12-31, which is excluded: January 1 to December 31, 2024, 366 days in a leap year. Sales in 2024: 3600.
